title: I've been using xDrip for about a year with the G5, I've had only one transmitter last past 90 days...Dexcom is starting to ask questions.
body:
The last transmitter lasted a measly 13.5 days!

Is there anything on xDrip that could be causing this?  I'm on a Moto Z2 Play and not using the receiver.

Thanks,
Jon

comments.body: As far as I know they just activate in the box before they are even put in to use and that drains the battery before you start.

@Jieseldeep Would you please close this issue unless you believe there is a bug with xDrip in this respect.
Otherwise, if you still have questions, you can also use the xDrip facebook support group.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
Or the Gitter room.   https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Thanks
